counterfactual_algorithm.admission: greedy; admit when actual original-tokenizer input tokens plus generation reserve fit context_limit; skip a non-fitting unit and continue
counterfactual_algorithm.input_units: the exact paid/receiver-derived remote_units from the saved stage; context-distinct units remain distinct
counterfactual_algorithm.name: stable_target_round_robin_v1
counterfactual_algorithm.rounds: one unit per target in target order, then the second unit per target, continuing until exhausted
counterfactual_algorithm.scope: counterfactual admission only; no GoT call and no driving output
counterfactual_algorithm.target_order: first appearance in frozen receiver-v1 order: anchor distance, provider, track_handle, field kind, context identity, field identity
